sv.title: Molly, 14, dog – nu har Alina fått vittna
sv.summary: Molly Gnospelius, 14, dog i en överdos. Bästa vännen Alina har väntat i fyra år på att få vittna om vad som egentligen hände. – Molly missbrukade inte tramadol. Hon testade en gång – den kvällen, säger Alina Sotolongo Backén, 18.

en.title: Molly, 14, died – now Alina has been allowed to testify
en.summary: Molly Gnospelius, 14, died of an overdose. Her best friend Alina has waited four years to testify about what actually happened. "Molly did not abuse tramadol. She tried it once – that evening," says Alina Sotolongo Backén, 18.
